name: cartography-plugins
description: Workspace-agnostic Claude Code tooling: cartography of an existing system by functionality, from its code or from an observed functionality, git commit and pull request conventions executed by narrow agents, and a challenge-then-interview workflow turning a raw idea into a functional spec.

plugins.name: cartography
plugins.description: Reverse engineers an existing system into a functional cartography, from its code in any language or from a functionality observed or described: an index of what lives where, one detail entry per use case, and the refusal surface. Ships the cartographer and scout agents, the format specification with its templates, and a validator.

plugins.name: git-conventions
plugins.description: Commit and pull request conventions executed by two narrow agents: committer writes a Conventional Commits + Gitmoji message for the staged changes and commits it after a shape check; pr-opener writes a pull request from the commits and opens or updates it. Neither ever stages, pushes, merges or rewrites history.

plugins.name: feature-spec
plugins.description: Turns a raw product idea into one feature of a functional specification organized by feature and use case, through a mandatory challenge, then interview, then write sequence. Ships the spec-writer agent and the workflow-feature-spec skill with its feature and use case templates. Never invents a missing fact, never settles an open reflection, never publishes anywhere.
